messages:
Alex: Quick mid-quarter OKR check for Inference pillar — short status please (ships / slips / owners / blockers). I pulled a quick table from tracker below. Can folks confirm or correct by EOD?

Alex: TL;DR: shipped 3 items, 1 slipped to next quarter, a couple small follow-ups. Need CR pings for two open PRs and a clear owner for the autoscale handoff.

Maya: Shipped: 1) runtime v2 memory optimizations (PR #4821 merged) ✅ 2) console route-level latency dashboard (PR #4870 merged) ✅ 3) batch cache hinting (feature flag) rolled to 25% ✅

Maya: Slipped: Dedicated autoscale policy UI (blocked by infra on the quota API). Owner was listed as Jin, but infra dependency moved it out.

Jin: Confirming infra quota work slipped our timeline. ETA for quota API work from eng-infra is 2 weeks (blocked on cloud provider rate limit changes). I can own the UI rollout once quota is in, but need someone to own the interim UX copy/flag gating.

Priya: I can take interim UX/flag gating work. Will open a small PR to add the UI toggles + doc note. Ping me for review: @Maya @Sam.

Devon: Note: batch cache hinting had a small regression in end-to-end perf tests — tail latency bump for seq_len > 2048 on one node type. Reproduced locally. Created issue #659. Working on a hotfix branch.

Sam: Assigning CRs — please thumbs-up where appropriate:
Sam: - PR #4821 (runtime mem opt) needs final perf ack from Jin / Devon.
Sam: - PR #4889 (canary autoscale config) needs review from Alex & Maya.

Maya: I can do #4889 review today.

Jin: I'll run perf sweep for #4821 tonight and post numbers in this thread.

Devon: Hotfix branch for batch cache regression is in draft: PR #4902. @Sam can you take a look? It's small but touching scheduler heuristic.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for batch-cache-hinting feature-flag at 2026-03-20T09:12:00Z.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy failed on instance pool a (OOM on p4x-node). Rolling back to previous stable.

Maya: Ugh. That matches the tail latency report. Rolling feature back to 5% and halting further ramps until #4902 merges + perf validated.

Alex: For the OKR notes:
Alex: - Shipped: runtime mem opt, latency dashboard, partial batch hinting (rolled back to 5%)
Alex: - Slipped: Dedicated autoscale UI (blocked by infra quota) -> owner: Jin (for final rollout) + Priya (interim flag gating)
Alex: - Blockers: infra quota API, batch-cache perf regression, canary instability on p4x-node

Alex: Immediate asks:
Alex: 1) Jin — post perf sweep numbers for #4821 by EOD (so we can mark as validated).
Alex: 2) Devon — prioritize #4902 hotfix and get at least one bench run green.
Alex: 3) Priya — open UX/flagging PR and add short doc blurb.
Alex: 4) Sam/Maya — finish CRs (#4889, #4902) and stamp when green.

Priya: Will open PR in the next 3 hours and add a short rollout checklist.

Jin: Running perf sweep now; will comment with bench output in ~2h.

Devon: I can get a bench run within 4 hours, will attach traces/logs.

Sam: I'll queue reviews for the PRs and do a quick ops runbook update for the autoscale handoff.

Alex: Great — once the three items above are green we'll update the OKR sheet and mark "partial complete" for batch hinting.

Maya: Quick note for support: I'll send a short heads-up to CS about the rollback + expected ETA for fix.

Alex: Thanks all. Will follow up in tomorrow's async OKR digest. :thumbsup:
